result.topic_en: Riemann transforms a product of two integrals of the form $\int_0^\infty e^{\pm x^2 i} x^{\alpha\pm ti}/(e^{x\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\sqrt\pi})\,dx$ into a double integral via $x=r(1+z)$, $y=r(1-z)$, evaluates residue sums, and studies a theta-like series $f(s,v)$ and its functional/recurrence relations in $v$.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-xxi}x^{\alpha-ti}\,\partial x}{e^{x\sqrt\pi}-e^{-x\sqrt\pi}} \cdot \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{+yyi}y^{\alpha+ti}\,\partial y}{e^{y\sqrt\pi}-e^{-y\sqrt\pi}}$

$x=r(1+z)$
$y=r(1-z)$
$2\int_0^\infty\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{e^{-2zrr i}\,r^{(1+2\alpha)}(1+z)^{\alpha-ti}(1-z)^{\alpha+ti}\,\partial z\,\partial r}{(e^{(1+z)r\sqrt\pi}-e^{-(1+z)r\sqrt\pi})(e^{(1-z)r\sqrt\pi}-e^{-(1-z)r\sqrt\pi})}$

$\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}=1+z\quad \frac{\partial x}{\partial z}=r$
$\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}=1-z\quad \frac{\partial y}{\partial z}=-r$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}\frac{\partial x}{\partial z}=-2r$

$f(s)=\sum\frac{e^{-\frac12 ss\,nn\pi i+\frac12 nn\pi i+n\pi i}}{e^{sn\pi i}-e^{-sn\pi i}}$ [struck through by a diagonal line]
$\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{-\frac12(ns+v)^2\pi i+\frac12 nn\pi i+n\pi i}}{e^{(sn+v)\pi i}-e^{-(sn+v)\pi i}}$ [struck through by a diagonal line]

methods.what: Change of variables x=r(1+z), y=r(1-z) turning a product of two integrals into a double integral, with Jacobian -2r
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}\frac{\partial x}{\partial z}=-2r$

methods.what: Residue evaluation at poles $(1+z)r\sqrt\pi=n\pi i$, giving a sum over residues
